notes.title: Draconic Date is live!
notes.content: We hope you like this short story, tell us and we might make more :)

notes.title: Alive and kicking!
notes.content:
Worry not, we are still alive and doing well! We are currently working on our next big game: Magical Hellhound Lust. But to make the wait a bit more tolerable, we bring to you Draconic Date, totally remastered.

Enjoy the direct continuation of Magical Waifus Academy's story on your date with Iryl, the Dragon Queen of the Icy Peaks.

Explore a mysterious... and strangely familiar... castle, as female or male character. And finish your date with some of the juiciest pixelart!


Wishlist the game and visit our website wataponno dot com for all the latest infos, newsletter, and more.
